rows.quant: INR 400.16 cr solar modules, by March 2027; ~7.5% of mcap
rows.text: reports that its **material subsidiary Saatvik Solar Industries Private Limited has received and accepted an order aggregating INR 400.16 crore for the supply of solar photovoltaic modules**, to be **executed by March 2027**. The Regulation 30 annexure is otherwise complete — domestic entity, commercial in nature, no promoter or promoter-group interest, not a related-party transaction — with **one deliberate omission: the counterparty is described only as "one renowned Independent Power Producer / EPC Player" and is not named**. At ~7.5% of a Rs 5,324.43 cr market cap it is a full quarter's worth of module offtake committed in a single order, and it sits in movers rather than a theme line because a single named buyer, a single stated value and a single execution deadline are all present — only the buyer's identity is withheld.
